headline: Axia Returns to Profitability in Q3 as Shares Approach Support Level
summary: Axia returned to a profit in the third quarter, though the result missed market expectations and its stock approached a technical support level at R$ 46.21.
why: Earnings misses relative to consensus forecasts often lead to technical testing of key support levels in equity valuations.

impacts.name: Axia
impacts.why: Q3 earnings coming in below expectations created downward pressure on the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
